abstract: We studied CT patterns in 21 cases of primary benign retroperitoneal tumor including teratoma in nine cases, schwannoma in six, leiomyoma in three, lipoma in one, lymphangioma in one, and neurofibroma in one. The tumors were analyzed for size, internal homogeneity, CT density, calcification, border with neighboring organs, and contrast enhancement (CE). The mean diameter of the tumors was 10.2 (+/- 4.8) cm. Internal homogeneous distribution was observed in 33%, calcification in 43%, and well-defined border in 86%. The CT density and calcification were compared according to histology, and the results were as follows: teratoma showed fat density in 78%, water density in 100%, and calcification in 89%; schwannoma showed water density in 100% and septal CE in 33%; leiomyoma showed soft tissue density in 100%, CE in 100%, and water density in 33%; lipoma showed fat density and calcification; and lymphangioma and neurofibroma showed water density. Internal homogeneity, fat density, cyst formation, and calcification are considered to be important predictors of primary benign retroperitoneal tumor on CT.
abstract_ja: われわれは、原発性良性後腹膜腫瘍21例のCT所見を検討した。内訳は、奇形腫9例、神経鞘腫6例、平滑筋腫3例、脂肪腫1例、リンパ管腫1例、神経線維腫1例であった。腫瘍について、大きさ、内部均一性、CT値、石灰化、隣接臓器との境界、造影効果(CE)を分析した。腫瘍の平均径は10.2(±4.8)cmであった。内部均一な分布は33%、石灰化は43%、境界明瞭は86%に認められた。CT値および石灰化を組織型ごとに比較したところ、次の結果が得られた。奇形腫では脂肪濃度が78%、水濃度が100%、石灰化が89%に認められた。神経鞘腫では水濃度が100%、隔壁状のCEが33%に認められた。平滑筋腫では軟部組織濃度が100%、CEが100%、水濃度が33%に認められた。脂肪腫では脂肪濃度と石灰化、リンパ管腫と神経線維腫では水濃度を示した。内部均一性、脂肪濃度、嚢胞形成、石灰化は、CTにおける原発性良性後腹膜腫瘍の重要な予測因子と考えられる。
